text: This landing keeps the browserRequest chrome-window filter and polls oAuthWindow.getBrowser each time. It resolves the async helper only after the current browser has a non-about:blank URI and a present, nonloading webProgress. A concrete ConfigVerifier caller arms the helper before verification and awaits it before aborting. This does not check a provider URL, login form or authentication success. The reported transient unload/browserLoaded cause remains attributed, and the separate caller promise join and later retry/catch repairs are distinct phases. No browser, navigation or OAuth test was run.
title: The OAuth prompt helper polls the current browser rather than retaining its initial load wait
